generationLimits: Client system prompts and reasoning allocation differ; record actual usage, do not claim equal inference compute. Preserve technical startup failures separately; no performance-based retries.
execution: Signal after close t, execution at close t+1, earns(t+1,t+2]; start in cash, exit wins; mark-to-market at end without invented final liquidation.
aggregation: Equal initial capital across all six rules within each market; median of those nine market returns is a comparison statistic, not a single portfolio account. Show every cost scenario separately.
publicationGate: Require at least two genuine accepted provider submissions and a common future start after all freeze/publication timestamps. Draft seasons cannot produce ranked results.
